title: DefectDojo — Privilege Escalation via unguarded is_staff in API v2 user endpoint

affected_technologies.component: API v2 user endpoint — dojo/api_v2/serializers.py UserSerializer.validate() (missing is_staff guard); Django admin site (/admin/) enabled by default

request_signatures: PATCH/PUT to /api/v2/users/<id>/ with a JSON body containing "is_staff": true, sent with a non-superuser API token
Immediately followed by access to /admin/ and a POST to /admin/auth/user/<id>/change/ toggling is_superuser
behavioral: A user account transitioning is_staff false->true, or is_superuser false->true, that was not performed by an existing superuser
Non-superuser accounts (holding only auth.change_user) accessing the Django admin site
Audit-log / DB entries where auth_user.is_staff or is_superuser changed via the API rather than the admin UI by a superuser

steps: Upgrade the DefectDojo containers/package to a fixed release (2.58.3 / 2.58.4 / 3.0.0+).
Audit auth_user for accounts with is_staff=1 or is_superuser=1 that should not have them and revoke; review who holds the 'Configuration -> Users (change)' (auth.change_user) permission.
Disable the Django admin site unless explicitly required (set DD_DJANGO_ADMIN_ENABLED=False), and ensure /admin/ is restricted to superusers.
mitigations: Until upgraded, do NOT grant the auth.change_user / 'Configuration -> Users (change)' permission to non-superusers.
Set DD_DJANGO_ADMIN_ENABLED=False to remove the /admin/ escalation surface.
Front /api/v2/users/ and /admin/ with the WAF rule below to flag is_staff/is_superuser changes.

waf.combine: Alert/deny PATCH or PUT to /api/v2/users/<id>/ whose JSON body sets is_staff:true or is_superuser:true. Because a WAF cannot see the caller's superuser status, prefer alert-then-review, or scope the deny to tokens/sessions known to be non-admin.
waf.false_positive_notes: Legitimate superuser-driven user management also sets is_staff/is_superuser via the same endpoint, so a blanket block can break admin workflows — this is a coarse mitigation; the real fix is the vendor patch. Use it in monitor mode unless you can distinguish admin callers.
